% Formatting preserved from the original rebuttal workflow.
\newcommand{\responseWResponse}[1]{%
  \par\vspace{1ex}%
  \noindent\textbf{Response: #1}%
  \par\vspace{1ex}%
}
\newcommand{\response}[1]{%
  \par\vspace{1ex}%
  \noindent\textbf{#1}%
  \par\vspace{1ex}%
}
\newcommand{\reviewer}{\emph}
\newcommand{\reviewercomment}{\reviewer}
\newcommand{\reviewcomment}{\reviewercomment}% Compatibility with earlier template versions.
\newcommand{\comment}{\textcolor{red}}
\newcommand{\TODO}{\textcolor{red}}
\definecolor{RED}{rgb}{1,0,0}
\definecolor{BLUE}{rgb}{0,0,1}
\providecommand{\DIFadd}[1]{{\protect\color{blue}\uwave{#1}}}
\providecommand{\DIFdel}[1]{{\protect\color{red}\sout{#1}}}
\providecommand{\DIFaddFL}[1]{\DIFadd{#1}}
\providecommand{\DIFdelFL}[1]{\DIFdel{#1}}
